newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo buys U.S. genetics company.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo buys U.S. genetics company.

text.p: British drugs group Glaxo Wellcome Plc said on Friday it had purchased a California-based genetic research company, Spectra Biomedical Inc, for $9 million.
The U.S. group specialises in establishing links between specific genes and specific diseases, Glaxo said in a statement.
The two companies have already co-operated on searching for the genetic basis of migraine.
Glaxo Wellcome said the acquisition reflected its intention of being "a leader in 21st century medicine by using the power of large-scale genetic association studies to guide drug development."
Spectra Biomedical, based at Menlo Park, California, was founded in 1993. Glaxo Wellcome said it would not retain the company's 15 employees.
